title: Editor E0 task 12a: the member and Space profile grids render nodes, proven byte-identical to the type-keyed render by frozen goldens
detail: Decomposed from PROG-E0 on 2026-10-19 (owner: "Fan out and start building everything"; ADR-1325 sequence 10 → 11 → 12). The READ half of task 12. components/entity-blocks/entity-grid.tsx is generic over the cell item (GridRow<T>), so the one grid renders RowDef cells of ids and node rows of BlockNode alike with identical markup. lib/entity-blocks/node-ops.ts gains resolveNodeRowsFor(layout, kind): a rows document renders from its nodes (parseEntityLayout's projection, or a fresh upgrade for a layout built in code); the two pre-rows shapes keep the legacy resolver's geometry (template slots, the kind's starter) and are then upgraded, so every placement reaches the renderer as a node with its own bag. components/widgets/member-profile/member-profile-modules.tsx and components/widgets/space-profile/space-profile-modules.tsx render nodes on their grid paths (renderMemberNode / renderSpaceNode read node.content and node.style), so two Text blocks each draw their own words and a native node document renders instead of blanking. The flat paths and the editor's render-all-once node maps wrap a registry id in a transient node and stay type-keyed, as do OwnerBlockFrame and editHref, until 12b. The gate: member-profile-modules.golden.json and space-profile-modules.golden.json were rendered by the type-keyed renderer before the switch and the two .test.tsx files require the node renderer to reproduce them byte for byte; the one documented difference is a row wider than the kind allows, which folds (as the ADR-1831 write guard does) instead of dropping. Not in this row (12b, LIVE-1002): profile-layout-context (selectedId → selectedNid), live-profile-grid, profile-page-builder, the Space canvas editor files, the email studio editor files, the two owner layout previews, house-home.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];const g=fs.readFileSync('components/entity-blocks/entity-grid.tsx','utf8');if(!g.includes('export function EntityGrid<T'))bad.push('EntityGrid is not generic over the cell item');for(const [f,fn] of [['components/widgets/member-profile/member-profile-modules.tsx','renderMemberNode'],['components/widgets/space-profile/space-profile-modules.tsx','renderSpaceNode']]){const s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!s.includes('resolveNodeRowsFor('))bad.push(f+' does not resolve node rows');if(!s.includes('function '+fn+'('))bad.push(f+' has no '+fn);if(/layout\?\.content\?\.\[id\]\s*$/m.test(s)&&!s.includes('transientNode'))bad.push(f+' reads the sibling map on the render path')}for(const f of ['components/widgets/member-profile/member-profile-modules.golden.json','components/widgets/space-profile/space-profile-modules.golden.json','components/widgets/member-profile/member-profile-modules.test.tsx','components/widgets/space-profile/space-profile-modules.test.tsx'])if(!fs.existsSync(f))bad.push('missing '+f);if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1001: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the grid stops being generic, when either profile renderer stops resolving node rows or loses its node renderer, or when a golden or its gate test is deleted. The byte-for-byte equality itself is the two .test.tsx files in the test job.
